name: Leather 55
notes: Pebbled leather: flat-toned grains with the contrast between pebbles, crease network via deep walls. The fine-grained sibling was scrapped in review. Dual-gate architecture (docs/fractal-texture-math.md par.9): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so its structure survives the paint train; canvas-anchored delivery was considered for the damage textures and rejected in review in favour of dual-gating everything. Tips synthesized and calibrated from tips/leather.spec.json (levels 30/55/80 = core-band stroke coverage); spectral verification by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. Half-covered hide.
